scope: Integrate G2/G3 explicit altera_syncram M20K BRAM wrapper into the main RTL while keeping a behavioral Verilator fallback; add directed BRAM TB and record unaligned/cross-word risk.

runs.summary: Default Verilator lint over rtl/filelist.f, top lcvex_core. PASS.

runs.command: verilator --binary --timing --assert -Wall -Wno-fatal -Wno-UNUSEDPARAM -Wno-DECLFILENAME --top-module lcvex_bram_boot_tb -Mdir build/bram_tb -o lcvex_bram_boot_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_bram_boot.sv tb/sv/lcvex_bram_boot_tb.sv && ./build/bram_tb/lcvex_bram_boot_tb
runs.summary: BRAM_BOOT_TB PASS. Covers prog loading, same-address write/read, partial byte enables, within-word unaligned access, debug read port, out-of-range fault.
SOC_SMOKE_ALL_PASS: positive JTAG-UART marker + DDR jump, cal-blocked no DDR traffic. Boot image loaded through prog_we.

quartus.m20k_evidence: Inherited from T-20260830-029 (16KB-1MB standalone PASS, M20K True Dual Port, 0 MLAB) and T-20260830-030 (A10 blackbox+shim through fit/STA/SOF). The main RTL wrapper uses the same altera_syncram parameters.

artifacts.reproduce: SYNTHESIS-aware wrapper: explicit altera_syncram M20K for Quartus, behavioral byte-address fallback for Verilator.
Standalone explicit altera_syncram M20K wrapper, not in normal Verilator filelists.
Distinct-name compatibility shim wrapping the main selector.
Directed BRAM wrapper TB; BRAM_BOOT_TB PASS.

known_limits: No new local/remote Quartus run in this task; M20K mapping is inherited from G2/G3 evidence.
Explicit M20K wrapper does not implement cross-8B-word accesses; such accesses return fault rather than being silently mis-written. Intra-word unaligned accesses are rotated.
Board M20K contents still require configuration stream/MIF or a future boot loader; explicit wrapper keeps prog_we as tie-off in synthesis.
No complete B5 full flow or actual board test performed.
